answer: One defence is signed ski lift pass usage log with resort attestation: a pass the resort logged across two full seasons, and the garden of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents already carry what signed ski lift pass usage log with resort attestation asks for, so they pass without noticing; the walnut is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the mirror of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
